## Hypothesis checks (mechanical)

- H3, MOT17-05: filter has fewer transitions/min in 10 of 10 conditions; onset delay change -0.01 to +0.19 s; more missed events in 1 of 10 conditions.
- H3, MOT17-11: filter has fewer transitions/min in 10 of 10 conditions; onset delay change +0.02 to +0.03 s; more missed events in 0 of 10 conditions.
